name: TCL 50P735
summary: TCL 50P735 ships with TCL analytics, promo rows and Google extras. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This TCL runs Android TV 11 and ships with TCL analytics and logging, plus content, promo and recommendation rows. TCL partner customizers, an overseas app show, a store demo sticker and a channel service push content in. Google extras such as videos, games and a music app, and a cleaner, game bar and hearing aid app are also listed.

This list was shared by one owner, so treat it as provisional. The build and a reboot check were not reported. TidyTV turns the apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything, so each one can be switched back on.
